verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a public OpenAPI v3 document that includes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints, so received legal documents are exposed through a documented machine interface. Agents can authenticate with server-to-server OAuth client credentials. Read access appears to be the default, since only create/update/delete need extra grants, and retry and rate-limit guidance supports automation. Missing for 10: endpoint-level evidence of what delivery metadata fields and document-file downloads are returned, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually retrieving documents.
